opsx-propose.description: Propor uma nova mudanca com OpenSpec (gera proposal, design, tasks)
opsx-propose.template: Load the openspec-propose skill and run the proposal workflow for what I want to build.

opsx-apply.description: Implementar tarefas de uma mudanca OpenSpec existente
opsx-apply.template: Load the openspec-apply-change skill and start implementing the current change.

opsx-explore.description: Modo exploratorio OpenSpec - investigar ideias e requisitos
opsx-explore.template: Load the openspec-explore skill and enter explore mode.

opsx-archive.template: Load the openspec-archive-change skill and archive the current change.

opsx-sync.description: Sincronizar delta specs de uma mudanca OpenSpec para os specs principais
opsx-sync.template: Load the openspec-sync-specs skill and sync delta specs for the current change.
